reel.exTrans: = He gives me the book. (du gibst · er gibt)
reel.payoff: Now use it in every tense 💪

caption:
„geben“ (to give) does two things 🤲
e → i in the present (du gibst, er gibt) — and it hides in „es gibt“ = there is / there are.
Er gibt mir das Buch. = He gives me the book.
